headline: SalfaCorp Takes $33 Million Hit From Centinela Mine Project Overruns
summary: Chilean builder SalfaCorp reported a reduction in projected profits of nearly 30 billion pesos ($33 million) due to technical demands and cost overruns at Minera Centinela.
why: SalfaCorp is one of Chile's principal engineering and construction companies.

impacts.name: SalfaCorp
impacts.why: Cost overruns on a major mining contract led to profit cuts.
